EOMasters News

Map of Coastal Indicators Released

Coastal areas are crucial ecosystems, supporting a diverse range of plants and animals. Monitoring these areas via satellites allows for better exploration and protection. The Coastal Map presented in this document provides high-resolution data (approximately 10 meters) essential for analysing and processing information about coastal zones. It uses the WSG84 projection and is divided into 3x3 degree grid files, significantly reducing the workload and processing time for ecological assessments. The map provides 4 important indicators for coastal areas. The details about the freely accessible data and how was generated can be found in the document at Zenodo.

  • Coastal Map | EOMasters

  • Coastal Map – Global High-Resolution Coastal Areas Map (zenodo.org)

Update of EO Data DB

The EO Data DB got updated. Thanks to Ben who provided some suggestions. Now WEkEO and Eumetsat Data Store information for S3 and S6 got updated. The valuable SRAL instrument has been added too.

In addition, it is now possible to filter the entries by thematic application, like atmosphere, land and marine and also by the platform the sensor is installed.

  •  EO Data DB (eomasters.org)

The Future of Copernicus Sentinel Missions

Artist's concept of Copernicus Expansion Missions

Discover how Europe’s latest satellite missions are set to revolutionize Earth Observation. These six new missions will expand the current Sentinel fleet, providing unprecedented insights into our planet’s dynamics. From tracking greenhouse gases to monitoring polar ice, get ready for a new era of environmental monitoring and climate action!

  • Advancing Earth Observation with the Copernicus Sentinel Expansion Missions

Revolutionizing Earth Observation with Super-Resolution Techniques

ESA’s TPM Manager, Peggy Fischer, at the SUREDOS24 workshop

The recent SUREDOS24 workshop highlighted cutting-edge super-resolution (SR) and downscaling techniques in Earth Observation (EO). Leveraging deep learning and AI, these methods enhance the spatial, spectral, and temporal resolution of satellite imagery. Key applications include climate modeling, agriculture, and urban development. ESA’s Third-Party Mission (TPM) programme highlighted missions like WorldView-3 and Pléiades Neo, demonstrating significant advancements in image clarity and detail.

  • Meet the future of Earth Observation: Super-Resolution Data

  • SUREDOS24 Presentations

Ensuring High-Quality Air Pollution Forecasts

Daily maximum dust particulate matter concentration at ground level

Credit: European Union, Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service 

This article delves into the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS), highlighting its critical role in providing reliable data on air pollution, health, and climate. It explains the evaluation and quality control processes that ensure the accuracy of CAMS forecasts, which are essential for managing air quality and mitigating health risks. Also, the global impact of air pollutants and the importance of independent evaluations in maintaining user confidence is discussed.

  • Putting the ‘quality’ in air quality measurements

CSIRO's NovaSAR-1 CEOS-ARD products available

This article highlights CSIRO’s operation of the NovaSAR-1 satellite, enabling remote sensing research and Earth observation. The facility offers access to CEOS-ARD compliant data, enabling efficient environmental monitoring and analysis. Learn about the workflows developed for generating high-quality satellite data and the benefits for Earth observation and analytics. NovaSAR-1's outstanding feature is its low-cost S-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) platform, which allows for all-weather, day-and-night imaging. This capability is particularly valuable for applications such as vegetation monitoring, soil moisture assessment, and maritime surveillance.

  • NovaSAR-1 CEOS-ARD products available

Upcoming deployment of the new Sentinel 2 processing base line

Credits: ESA

ESA will deploy Processing Baseline 05.11 on July 23, 2024. This update includes improvements in geolocation accuracy, quality mask corrections, and snow/ice detection. It also introduces a new AOT retrieval method and supports upcoming Sentinel-2C/D specifications.

  • Deployment of Sentinel-2 Processing Baseline in version 05.11 on 23 July

Plugin Updates for QGIS

In June 2024 new plugins were updated in the QGIS plugin repository. The blog lists them with a brief description so that you can find the ones that are important to you.

  • Plugin Update – June, 2024

Tschüss and Goodbye!
